req.title: List all tasks
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /tasks/ with a JSON array of all tasks, honouring optional skip and limit query parameters.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the 'List all tasks' functionality of the task management API. It includes tests for normal operation, boundary conditions, and invalid inputs to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_list_all_tasks_positive
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with 20 tasks.
actions: Send a GET request to /tasks/ without any query parameters.
expected: The response JSON is an array of 20 tasks.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.get("/tasks/")
assert response.status_code == 200
assert len(response.json()) == 20

tests.name: test_list_all_tasks_negative_invalid_skip
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with 20 tasks.
actions: Send a GET request to /tasks/ with skip=-1.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.get("/tasks/?skip=-1")
assert response.status_code == 422

tests.name: test_list_all_tasks_boundary_limit
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with 20 tasks.
actions: Send a GET request to /tasks/ with limit=1000.
expected: The response JSON is an array of 20 tasks.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.get("/tasks/?limit=1000")
